Saturday morning was quite bright and unusually warm for November. My mother was still getting up and, sadly, did not have the opportunity to experience this strange event. When someone we love leaves us unexpectedly like David did to join the ranks of those who have passed on before him or her, it is a moment laden with profound questions. In this case, he was taken from us by an embolism; and yet when I think about my brother's death, that detail seems irrelevant. It seems as if we live in two worlds - one made up of the material existence which we experience through our physical senses (our bodies), emotions, thoughts, memories etc., and a world beyond.
